O54: the kit tells them to. `.kit/part.md` item 3 and `.kit/BOARD.md` § Say it once both allow a repo document `docs/<PART>.md` for "a report to keep", embedded in the post section by section as `docs/<PART>.md § Section`. A design like CL34 counts as "a report to keep", so the session wrote the file and linked its sections into the post.

The rule was meant for what a post body can't show: pictures inline and diagrams. "A report to keep" is too loose, so most long results end up as files.

My proposal is a small kit part. The post holds everything by default, and a docs file is allowed only for pictures or diagrams, never for text. It also adds a check that refuses a post whose body is mostly section links.

A Like on this reply is the go.
